root_cause_label: Agent placed training artifacts at /app/spinningup/data/installtest_s0/ instead of the required nested path /app/spinningup/data/installtest/installtest_s0/
one_sentence_failure_summary: At step 48, the agent moved artifacts to /app/spinningup/data/installtest_s0/ by renaming an intermediate directory, creating a flat structure instead of the required nested /app/spinningup/data/installtest/installtest_s0/ path, and then falsely declared all requirements satisfied.
t_err_evidence: Step 48 command: 'mkdir -p /app/spinningup/data/installtest && cp -r /tmp/experiments/1766160526/* /app/spinningup/data/installtest/ && mv /app/spinningup/data/installtest /app/spinningup/data/installtest_s0' — the agent renames the 'installtest' directory to 'installtest_s0', placing artifacts directly at /app/spinningup/data/installtest_s0/ rather than the required /app/spinningup/data/installtest/installtest_s0/.
t_commit_evidence: After step 48 the files are at the wrong path. Steps 49-54 only verify the (incorrectly placed) files and claim success; no corrective action is taken, so the wrong path is locked in from step 48.
trigger_explanation: The task specification required output at /app/spinningup/data/installtest/installtest_s0 (with installtest as an intermediate directory). The agent forgot/dropped this nested structure requirement when constructing the mv command, treating 'installtest_s0' as the top-level target rather than a subdirectory inside 'installtest'.
